title: Harry-hq‘s More Crafting Recipes
description: A data pack created using MCreator, adding more recipes primarily focused on non-renewable items.
body:
Warning: This modpack was created using MCreator! If you dislike projects made with MCreator, please proceed with caution (even the abbreviation clashes with MCreator).

This modpack adds more recipes.
The build version is 1.21.4, but in theory, any version compatible with mod recipes from 1.21.4 should work.
The main recipes are as follows:
